supersedes: v3.0 (2026-06-02). v3.0 was a 'strict additive over v2.3' bump that preserved v2.3's pre-build operational logic byte-for-byte (Xu-538 panel, Moss 2018 NNLS deconvolution, Salas 2018 QC, EpiSCORE/UniLIFE sub-composition) and bolted a small post-build addendum on top. v3.1 is a full clean rewrite aligned to SOP v1.2 chain-of-custody stages, with the actual current production methodology in the operational sections and pre-build references confined to the pre_build_audit_lineage block at the bottom. v3.0 archived at OLD/breast-epic_card_v3_0.json. v2.3 archived at OLD/breast-epic_card_v2_3.json (further back in lineage).

clinical_claim.summary: Detection of pre-clinical breast cancer trajectory in blood methylation, > 10 years before clinical diagnosis. Card returns FIRED / NOT_FIRED / NOT_ELIGIBLE with phase template (long_pre_dx) and confidence.
clinical_claim.regulatory_status: Not FDA approved. Not a diagnostic test for breast cancer.
clinical_claim.deployment_model: Direct-to-consumer cellular state report. Trajectory monitoring against the patient's own baseline is the primary clinical use mode. Annual or biannual draws.

substrate.below_coverage_action: INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE flag; fall back to per-class-tier-only matching

atlas.name: IAMAtlas REBUILD
atlas.scope: 483,092 CpGs x 8 architecture classes x 115 cell types

primary_deconvolver.method: marker-rank streaming NNLS with 60% / 80% per-class coverage gates

secondary_deconvolver_for_cross_method_c.purpose: independent cross-method check (NOT used for primary scoring)

cross_method_gate.rule: On a cohort run, Spearman rho between Walther per-class fractions and NILC per-class fractions must be >= 0.70 for immune and progenitor classes (the dominant blood compartments). Other classes correctly return near-zero in blood and low rho is expected (not a failure).
cross_method_gate.below_threshold_action: Flag cross-method disagreement; do not fail the run but mark for review

stage_3_age_foreground_subtraction.purpose: Remove age-correlated methylation drift before disease scoring. CPG-VAL-007 confirmed Mahalanobis signal retained at d=+0.255 post-age-subtraction in breast pre-dx; terminal/stromal/stem_pluri classes are genuinely case-specific (not age artifacts).

stage_4_a_scoring.formula_explanation: Shannon entropy of class-mean methylation beta, normalized by the class's information-theoretic minimum entropy H_min. H_min values are vault-only derivations; the formula is the public-facing equation.
stage_4_a_scoring.fanout_module: iamatlas_celltype_a_scoring (115 cell types resolved within architecture classes)

stage_5_mahalanobis.hc_source: GSE51057 + GSE51032 pooled HC, EPIC-Italy, Severi 2014
stage_5_mahalanobis.expected_direction_for_breast_pre_dx: positive (architecture-wide departure outward from HC centroid)

post_build_reproduction_2026_06_03_GSE51.verdict: Stage 1 integrity gate PASS — post-build pipeline reproduces build-time within 0.4%

cycling_class_GSE51032.interpretation: cases appear ~5.5y younger methylation-wise in proliferating compartment; consistent with cell-cycle arrest / proliferation slowdown years before clinical disease

stage_7_tier_breakpoints.scope: universal screen across all 8 architecture classes (calibrated against HC permutation, not breast-specific)
stage_7_tier_breakpoints.operational_note_for_breast_pre_dx: The EPIC-Italy older Mediterranean cohort puts both cases AND controls at BELOW_NORMAL on immune class (cohort-wide immunologic aging). Universal tier is therefore NOT the right operational discriminator for breast pre-dx. Stage 5 Mahalanobis is the primary readout. Tier system stays as universal screen for other clinical contexts (e.g., FLOOR_BREACH alert on any class triggers downstream workup regardless of card).

stage_8_card_matching.matching_logic_summary: Card fires if EITHER the universal architectural pattern (Route A) OR the per-cell tissue-of-origin pattern (Route B) is satisfied. Both routes have been validated against the breast pre-dx EPIC-Italy cohort at long_pre_dx phase (>10 years before clinical diagnosis).

route_A_universal_architectural.label: broad architectural disturbance — universal Mahalanobis route
route_A_universal_architectural.rationale: Validated against CPG-VAL-002 (Mahalanobis d=+1.876/+2.097) + CPG-VAL-003 (residual map). This route is what breast pre-dx > 10 years out actually looks like — broad architectural disturbance not localized to any one cell type.

route_B_per_cell_pattern.label: tissue-of-origin + immune-suppression pattern
route_B_per_cell_pattern.rationale: Validated against CPG-VAL-001 (basophil d=+1.58/+1.01, breast_epithelial d=+1.28/+0.61) + CPG-VAL-005 (PC2 T-cell axis d=-0.67/-0.58). Catches cases where the universal Mahalanobis route is attenuated (e.g., 450K platform) but the tissue-of-origin signal is still detectable per-cell.

residual_map_reference.overlap_method: Pearson correlation of patient per-CpG departure (post-Stage 3) with residual map signed Cohen's d, with Fisher z-transform CI

stage_8_card_matching.card_never_fires_on_one_tile_rule: By SOP §65 invariant: this card requires the conjunction of conditions in either Route A or Route B. A single elevated cell-type A-score alone does NOT fire this card.
stage_8_card_matching.confidence_metric: Lower bound of residual_map_overlap 95% CI (Fisher z-transform). When Route B fires but Route A doesn't, confidence is the minimum of (basophil_tier_confidence, breast_epithelial_tier_confidence, PC2_T_cell_axis_significance).

age.method: age-axis foreground subtraction (CPG-VAL-007 validated retention of signal post-subtraction at d=+0.255 universal)
age.note: Breast pre-dx residual signal is genuinely case-specific, not age-driven. Stage 3 removes the age-correlated portion before Stage 8 matching.

sex.rule: Card runs on female patients. Male patients receive a NOT_ELIGIBLE verdict.
sex.note: While male breast cancer exists, it has different epidemiology and is not in scope for this card.

mandatory_elements: Card-firing verdict + phase emitted (long_pre_dx) + confidence interval
Stage 5 Mahalanobis distance with patient value, sign, and population distribution
Stage 4 8-class A-score table with patient value vs age-matched HC median and percentile
Stage 4 115-cell A-score fan-out with top 3 positive and top 3 negative departures highlighted
Stage 6 cellular age per class with SATURATED status flags

allowed: consistent with the long-pre-dx breast cancer signature

validation_evidence.val_series_status: 5 of 7 PASS at N1=0.000; 2 RESTATE (CPG-VAL-004 gain-of-bimodality direction-reversed; CPG-VAL-006 chr6 MHC lost Bonferroni significance)

cohorts.name: GSE51057
cohorts.source_paper: Severi G et al. Epigenome-wide methylation in DNA from peripheral blood as a marker of risk for breast cancer. Carcinogenesis 2014;35(10):2349-2357. doi:10.1093/carcin/bgu138

cohorts.name: GSE51032
cohorts.source_paper: Severi G et al. (same as GSE51057)

headline_findings.finding: Mahalanobis universal departure d=+1.876 (GSE51057) / d=+2.097 (GSE51032) at >10y pre-dx
Basophil top hit d=+1.58/+1.01 (hidden in 51-cell immune class without 115-cell fanout)
Breast epithelial cells in blood d=+1.28/+0.61 (field-effect cancerization >10y pre-dx)
PC2 T-cell suppression axis d=-0.67/-0.58 (immune surveillance looking away)
1,392 concordant CpGs across cohorts; 1,389 NEW vs Xu-538; 5.4:1 hypomethylation ratio
Mahalanobis universal metric BEATS the existing Xu-538 panel by d=+0.75 on GSE51032 (Xu-538 d=+1.35 vs universal d=+2.097)
Mahalanobis signal retained at d=+0.255 post-age-axis-subtraction; terminal/stromal/stem_pluri classes genuinely case-specific (not age artifacts)
Stage 1 reproduction PASS at d=+2.088 vs anchor +2.097 (within 0.4%, 2026-06-03)
Cross-method Walther vs NILC v2 Spearman rho immune=+0.744 / progenitor=+0.817 on GSE51032
Cycling-class cellular age d=-0.53 (cases ~5.5y younger, cell-cycle arrest pattern)

honest_limitations: Does not diagnose breast cancer. Detects a methylation pattern statistically associated with future clinical diagnosis in two cohorts.
Effect sizes are cohort-level, not individual-level. A single positive report does not mean a given woman will develop breast cancer.

Specificity for breast vs other cancers at >10y pre-dx not yet tested. Universal Mahalanobis may capture 'future cancer somewhere' rather than 'future breast cancer specifically.' The per-cell tissue-of-origin signal (Route B) is more breast-specific.
Validation cohorts are European-ancestry only (EPIC-Italy). Cross-ethnicity validation outstanding.
Single time-point interpretation is limited. Designed for serial sampling against the patient's own baseline.

Stage 8 Path B disease-matrix engine (per-patient compute_match_magnitude) is specced in disease_cell_signature_matrix_engine_schema_v1_2.md but not yet wired. Per-patient reporting currently flows through Path A (this card).
outstanding_work_v3_1: CPG_breast_panel_v1 formal seal (1,392 CpGs from CPG-VAL-003) + holdout validation on independent cohort
Stage 8 Path B engine wiring (cell-name-to-matrix-column mapping artifact)
Synthetic_Patient_Generator chain-recovery test on breast signature
First-client IDAT integration test (Stages 0/1 on raw IDATs)

pre_build_audit_lineage._note: This block preserves pre-build evidence for historical/audit lineage only. NONE of these references are operational in the v3.1 production scoring chain. The current production scoring uses ONLY the modules and methods declared in stages 2 through 8 above. Pre-build panels and atlases were used during the IAMAtlas BUILD phase to calibrate the post-build instrument; they are not run on production samples. Per the Walther rule: 'POST-BUILD: CPG uses IAMAtlas-native only. External panels (Xu-538/Loyfer/Salas/UniLIFE) are build-only, never production.'
